sources.title: sherckuith/qwen35-9b • LM Studio Hub
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5 represents a significant leap forward, integrating breakthroughs in multimodal learning, architectural efficiency, reinforcement learning scale, and global accessibility. This is a 9B parameter dense model, supporting a native context length of 262,144 tokens.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B: Specifications and GPU VRAM Requirements
sources.snippet: Qwen3.5-9B is Alibaba Cloud's efficient multimodal foundation model with 9B parameters, released February 2026. It uses a hybrid architecture combining Gated Delta Networks and Gated Attention in an 8× (3×DeltaNet→FFN→1×Attention→FFN) pattern.
